public_definitions: Goal: assign the browser with the highest current market_share to the priority compatibility-testing queue.
Queue rule: Prioritize highest current usage share; decision metric is market_share.
Options: Assign Edge / Assign Firefox / Assign Chrome to the priority compatibility-testing queue.
uncertain: The printed percentage labels do not sum to 100% (5+1+87+23+3 = 119), so the label set is internally inconsistent.

The visual bar heights conflict with the printed labels (Edge bar is tallest but labeled 87% while Firefox bar is shorter and labeled 23%); it is unclear whether to trust the printed numbers or the bar geometry for 'highest market_share'.
No explicit 'current' date or time-period marker is shown on the dashboard.
